title: What's your town's "open secret" that everyone knows but nobody talks about?
body: Every town has one. What's yours?

comments.content: The Hartwell Building's 13th floor. Everyone knows something's weird about it but asking questions just gets you a visit from "Patricia from HR."

replies.content: Hi! Just checking in! There's nothing weird about our perfectly normal building! 😊 What's your address?

comments.content: The quantum coffee "scene" is basically a cult at this point. Derek is their leader. His ex-wife Jennifer runs an anti-quantum-coffee blog. Their divorce was MESSY.
